steps.text: Every signature request is listed with its document, its origin, its progress, its deadline and its status. The filter at the top keeps only the requests of one status.
steps.title: The community's requests

steps.text: The **"Progress"** counts the signatures received: here **"0 of 1 signed"**, the participant has not signed yet.
steps.title: Where the request stands

steps.text: Click **"Send a reminder"**: every signer who has not signed yet gets a reminder by notification and by email.
steps.title: Remind the signer

steps.text: Click **"Open the details"** to see the whole request.
steps.title: Open the request

steps.text: The top of the page gives the request's status and its deadline. Under **"Signers"**, each one is listed with what they have done: invited, viewed, signed or declined.
steps.title: The signers

steps.text: The **"History"** traces every step, the reminder included. **"Log intact"** confirms that nobody has changed it. The signed document only appears once everyone has signed.
steps.title: The history
